title: Orange County Rose Society — Pruning a Rose

common.preserved_uncertainty: The page asks "Why, you may ask, should you consider leaving stems smaller than a pencil?" and then answers it *against* leaving them (thin stems produce ever-thinner stems). The dossier read this as questioning the pencil rule's strictness. See §3.
